error_reason: On opening Zillow’s PE sold page, the visible results and embedded data included a Yakima, WA listing, proving the dataset was not constrained to Prince Edward Island. Proceeding without correcting the region scope caused all subsequent filters and the final selection to be applied to the wrong result set, directly leading to the incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: Upon opening Zillow’s PE sold page, the visible results panel included a listing for '2014 S 62nd Ave, Yakima, WA 98903', indicating that the page’s results were not constrained to Prince Edward Island sales. Proceeding from this contaminated results context led all subsequent filtering and selection to be applied to an incorrect result set, making later steps inherit the error. Correctly ensuring the region filter strictly limited results to PE would have prevented the wrong final answer.
hypotheses.check: Inspect the screenshot/DOM from step 8 to confirm the results panel shows a Yakima, WA listing. Verify that Zillow’s region is not correctly constrained to Prince Edward Island and that the results set is mixed or mis-scoped. Compare with a correctly scoped Zillow PE sold search to show the discrepancy.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 8 assumes the Zillow page at /pe/sold is scoped to Prince Edward Island, but the screenshot and extracted JSON-LD show a Yakima, WA listing (2014 S 62nd Ave, Yakima, WA 98903) in the results panel, indicating the results are not correctly constrained to PE.

preconditions.condition: Clicking the Bing result 'https://www.zillow.com/pe/sold' will open a Zillow page whose results are scoped to Prince Edward Island sold listings.
preconditions.evidence: Step 6: "Please click on the first Zillow link related to sold homes in Prince Edward Island..."; Step 8 OCR shows: "2014 S 62nd Ave, Yakima, WA 98903" appearing in the PE sold results panel.

postconditions.condition: The opened Zillow page shows only Prince Edward Island sold listings.
postconditions.evidence: Step 8 OCR: "Prince Edward Island Recently Sold Homes ... 3 bds | 2 ba | 1,148 sqft - Sold 2014 S 62nd Ave, Yakima, WA 98903"; JSON-LD in Step 8 includes a Yakima, WA listing within the page data.

postconditions.condition: Subsequent filtering (Beds & Baths 2+) operates over a correctly scoped PE dataset.
postconditions.evidence: Step 12 and Step 16 actions apply filters on the same contaminated result set where Yakima, WA appears among PE results (Step 8 OCR and JSON-LD).
